rows.text: "Hey! Where am I? Why are there so many people arguing inside my head?" As you put forth your inquiries, a wave of deep rage surfaces in your cognition, desiring destruction and the ruination of everything.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You are now but a thread of consciousness. A thread of consciousness belonging to a perfect scholar. The members of the Intelligentsia Guild clamor ceaselessly next to your ears, arguing about the future, chaos, evolution, and languages. You listen to them murmur on and find their words meaningless.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: This will be a model created by collecting data from the greatest scholars of the Guild and combining the details together into one. The Intelligentsia Guild estimates that, in the best case scenario, the first perfect scholar of the Intelligentsia Guild will be born.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: As the lead scholar initiates the experiment, a new electric current surfaces within the consciousness.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Therefore, one question must be considered.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "The pursuit of the meaning of the self. I believe that it is repeating the process of becoming human." The scholar displays the digital incubator to the crowd.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Has a chance to obtain a Scepter of 2-star rarity.
Has a chance to obtain Component(s) of 2-star rarity.
The pursuit of knowledge is meaningless.
